verdict.rationale: Paperspace docs show Jupyter Notebooks (web-based IDE) and SSH-based machine access (docs-2, docs-7, docs-19) which could support VS Code/Cursor remote-SSH, but there is no explicit one-step IDE integration documented. Hands-on community reports directly contradict ease of SSH access ('Getting SSH access is an uphill battle... pointless virtual console and confusing GUI' - paperspace-comm-7) and note Gradient Notebooks are a poor experience for serious development (paperspace-comm-6), undermining the frictionless one-step claim. Missing for 10: explicit VS Code/Cursor 'Remote-SSH' or extension docs, confirmation of true one-step setup, and resolution of the SSH-access complaints.
